note: A DAY candidate and an HOUR candidate land on the same slot because a DAY move keeps the item's current start time, so the slot yields exactly one preview and the better score decides which snapshot pair it cites.
derivation: score = 0.80*relief - 0.20*changeCost with relief = improvement/100 and changeCost = min(1, |after - before| in minutes / 240), every step quantized to scale 6 HALF_EVEN. The item sits at 2026-09-12 10:00 KST for 90 minutes and both candidates move it to 2026-09-13; the DAY candidate carries no time, so it keeps 10:00 (D-REC-4) and both land on the slot 2026-09-13 10:00. The move is 1440 minutes, which saturates changeCost at 1.000000 for both. DAY 80 -> 40: relief 0.400000, 0.80*0.400000 = 0.320000, 0.20*1.000000 = 0.200000, score 0.120000. HOUR 80 -> 30: relief 0.500000, 0.400000 - 0.200000 = 0.200000. Both clear the minimum improvement of 5 and both scores are positive, so neither is rejected; section 5.6 keeps one preview per (date, start time) and score DESC awards the slot to the HOUR pair at 0.200000. The 09:00-18:00 window covers the 10:00-11:30 stay on every date and there are no locks and no neighbours, so no hard check fires.
